definitions: An online graphic design platform that allows users to create social media graphics, presentations, posters, documents, and other visual content.
A company that provides a web-based design tool with a drag-and-drop interface and a vast library of templates, stock photos, graphics, and fonts.
examples: She used Canva to design the invitation.
Canva offers both free and paid subscription plans.
Many small businesses rely on Canva for their marketing materials.
